Request reprint permissions here.The war on Iran, launched in late February by the United States and Israel, is doing more than rattling oil markets. It is accelerating a determination among African countries to reduce their dependence on imported fossil fuels and to turn toward renewable power. Africa has extraordinary solar, wind, and geothermal resources, but until the early 2010s, much of this potential had gone untapped. Most African states had long generated electricity from fossil fuels and hydropower, because these technologies were already well established, whereas solar and wind were the new, expensive kids on the block.That calculus began to change around 2022,
